description: Verify the tamper-evidence hash chain of a model's durable audit trail. Returns {valid, recordsChecked, firstBrokenSequence, detail}; a false 'valid' points at the first altered/reordered/deleted record. (Embedded mode has no hash chain and reports valid.)
name: verify_audit

firstBrokenSequence.description: Sequence of the first broken record, or null.

valid.description: True when the whole chain is intact.

title: Verify audit trail
